## HueMux v0.0.4-alpha.13 — Roundtrip-paced color probing, Auto columns, icon-only tiles

> **Alpha.** The color picker no longer spams the bridge: probes are paced by
> the measured pick→confirmation roundtrip and self-correct as the bridge
> speeds up or slows down. The columns setting gains an Auto mode, and the
> aggregate tiles become icon-only rows with always-tinted color buttons.

### Color probing paces itself to the bridge

Dragging in the color picker used to send a probe per animation frame; the
bridge applied each one in turn and its eventstream reported them all back, so
a tail of queued color updates kept re-colouring the lamps after the finger
lifted. Probes now run one at a time: the next pick is held as pending and
sent only when the in-flight probe is confirmed by the matching color change
coming back from the bridge. The probe→confirmation time feeds an EWMA, so
the pace self-corrects to whatever the bridge actually delivers, and a
timeout (rtt×3, 1s–4s) releases the budget when an event is lost — a missed
delta can slow one probe but never wedge the pipeline. At most one update
remains outstanding after the finger lifts.

### Auto columns mode

Settings → Light columns gains **Auto**: 2 per row on phones, 1 below 360 px,
3 and 4 at the wider breakpoints. Fixed 1–4 choices still override it
everywhere.

### Icon-only aggregate tiles

The all-lights and per-room tiles drop their title text — icon, color dots,
buttons, slider only. The color button on the tiles and on every light card
is now always tinted with the selected color, including while the light is
off, so the color stays visible without any label.
